map.出成率应该填多少？: What yield rate should I fill in?
map.出成率 = 净料重量 ÷ 毛料重量。肉类去骨去皮常在 70–90%，蔬菜择洗常在: Yield rate = net weight ÷ gross weight. Meat after deboning and skinning is usually 70-90%, vegetables after trimming and washing 60-85%. If unsure, start with 85%, then weigh after processing and come back to correct it.
